claims.statement: The slot correction was applied to the wrong feed and did not resolve the held-order condition
claims.limitation: Indicates our available corrective actions (revert, replay, slot correction) lack sufficient visibility into the multi-system carrier integration to fix the root cause unilaterally

claims.statement: The 186 stuck orders require carrier system intervention; our available mitigations (rule revert, allocation replay, slot correction) have each failed, indicating the root cause mechanism is on the carrier integration side and requires carrier-side diagnostics and fixes
claims.limitation: Evidence strongly suggests carrier system issue, but the specific failure point in the carrier integration (feed lag, queue backlog, confirmation timeout, system event at 05:58) has not been isolated by our diagnostics or our mitigations

next_action.rationale: Root cause established: carrier system integration failure (root_002) at approximately 05:58, causing 47-minute confirmation latency against a 30-minute slot deadline. Three reversible mitigations attempted: (1) revert allocation rules - ineffective, problem persists post-revert; (2) replay allocations - ineffective, slots already closed; (3) correct slot windows - ineffective, applied to wrong feed. The fundamental barrier is that the underlying carrier system failure requires carrier-side investigation and remediation. Recommend: (1) escalate to Carrier Operations with timeline of 05:58 failure point, (2) request carrier diagnostic on confirmation queue/feed lag, (3) coordinate with Carrier Ops for manual order pickup or carrier system remediation. Status: 186 orders held; mitigation blocked without carrier-side resolution.
